Senses.Explanation: The paired phrase tracks one exit and one entry as a single rhythm of encounter rather than two dictionary senses. Yuanwu frames the movement as a test, while Hongzhi’s marked appraisal of Pang Yun and Danxia supplies the clearest quoted original; later records preserve the same balanced motion.
